title: cost-model: add `explain` endpoint for breakdown + contributing factors (Console tooltips)
author: Jada Williams
description: Adds the Cost Model API `explain` endpoint used by Console cost breakdown tooltips and support/debug workflows. Motivation: Console needs an auditable, human-readable explanation of *why* a component cost is high/low (batching efficiency, KV-cache hits, prefill vs decode split, quant profile deltas, missing telemetry assumptions) without embedding SCM internals in the UI layer. This PR implements `POST /cost-model/v1/explain` (and the shared response types) on cost-model-service, wiring it to the deterministic calculation engine introduced in prior SCM PRs. The endpoint returns the same numeric breakdown as `estimate`, plus a bounded list of "contributing factors" with stable identifiers and UI-safe strings. It also includes explicit assumptions + confidence, and a minimal "input echo" for debugging (redacted / truncated to avoid sensitive payload leakage). API shape notes: (1) `explain` is *not* a tracing endpoint; it is deterministic given inputs and does not fetch per-request runtime traces; (2) it is safe to call for both Hosted and Dedicated; Private is supported when the caller provides SKU/region/quant metadata and/or opts into fallback assumptions; (3) payload size is explicitly bounded and the factors list is capped to prevent unbounded cardinality in downstream logs. Examples (used by Console tooltips) are included under `docs/examples/scm_explain_*.json` and cover: warm vs cold KV-cache, batching on/off, and quant profile swap. Security/PII: no prompts or raw request bodies are accepted; only metering/telemetry-derived counters and config metadata. The response avoids including tenant-specific pricing (SCM is technical cost attribution only). Audit logging for reads is handled in a follow-up (see ENG-23231), but this PR does tag requests with actor + tenant for later audit correlation. Rollout: endpoint is behind `scm.explain_endpoint_enabled` and returns `501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED` when disabled; Console will treat this as optional and fall back to showing numeric breakdown only.

api_summary: Auth: same as /estimate (service-to-service + tenant-scoped), rejects anonymous/internal-missing-tenant requests
Request: ExplainRequestV1 (same core inputs as EstimateRequestV1; optional flags: include_input_echo, max_factors)

Errors: INVALID_ARGUMENT (schema/validation), FAILED_PRECONDITION (missing required dims when strict), NOT_IMPLEMENTED (flag off), UNSUPPORTED_VERSION (version negotiation handled elsewhere)

review_conversation: Dylan Brooks: Can we guarantee factor IDs are stable across v1? Console wants to map a subset to tooltip copy and tests. Also please cap the number of factors so we don't blow up payload size on weird inputs.

Jada Williams (author): Yep—added `ContributingFactorId` enum in scm-types and a compile-time check in the renderer. Also added `max_factors` request param with server-side clamp (default 12, max 25).

Jordan Lee: Determinism: make sure the renderer doesn't pull in wall-clock / region defaults implicitly. I see `resolveRegion()` fallbacking to env var—can we force caller to pass region unless explicitly using assumptions?

Jada Williams (author): Good catch. Changed behavior: if `region` is missing and `strict=true` (default), we return FAILED_PRECONDITION with a structured error. If `strict=false`, we set assumption `region=unknown` and confidence drops accordingly.
Logan Wright: Please avoid echoing raw dimension maps back; even if it's "safe" it increases risk of log leakage. Can we only echo a small, allow-listed set and truncate evidence strings?

Jada Williams (author): Done. Input echo is allow-listed (model_id, gpu_sku, region, quant_profile_id, token counts) and evidence is truncated to 256 chars per factor; also added `warnings[]` when truncation occurs.

Marissa Cole: The examples are great—can we add one specifically showing the "low confidence" state and the exact copy Console should display? (We can iterate later but need something for support enablement.)

Jada Williams (author): Added `scm_explain_low_confidence_missing_cache_metrics.json` and aligned copy with the strings the renderer emits today. Note: Console should still own final UI phrasing; these examples are fixtures for engineering/testing.
Felix Schneider: Minor: please include `request_id` in response for correlation (not audit).
Jada Williams (author): Added `correlation_id` (propagates `X-Request-Id` if present; otherwise generates UUID).
